title: Netherite Reforged
description: Netherite Reforged alters the texture of all netherite-related blocks and items in order to fit in line with the rest of Minecraft.
body:
Netherite Reforged alters the texture of all netherite-related blocks and items in order to fit in line with the rest of Minecraft. This includes retexturing things like netherite armour to be consistent with previous tiers, changing the sticks in the weapons and tools, and more.

This texture pack is always being updated to keep up to date between versions and added items.
